info.title: aiunit-review
info.description: Avalonia 12 desktop tool (dotnet-tool aiunit-review) for discovering and visually reviewing aiUnit wireframe-to-screenshot comparison tests/scenarios (L wireframe / M pwsh chat via Iciclecreek terminal / R screenshot). Hosts Avalonia.RemoteControl debugging services for live inspection.
